answer_text: Yes. The CMA supports regaining admin access by resetting MFA for the administrator. In the CMA, go to Account > Administrators, select the affected admin, and reset their MFA permissions. After the reset, the admin will be redirected to a web page with a QR code to scan with an authenticator app to re-link CMA MFA to the new device. MFA is used for CMA when you authenticate with Cato credentials; if you want to avoid MFA for future admins, consider using SSO as the authentication method (SSO is supported).
